The “**Quick Win**” Strategy Paired with a **No Brainer Offer**

Now For Person \#1 I’m assuming you are already putting out content, your Messaging is on point, You have active Convos going and you have some type of Audience.

With that being said I’ll share what I've personally been doing to hit some big numbers with multiple different offers.

I never Try to sell at first, I know it sounds crazy, but it's true\!

**“Relationship over Revenue, build the relationship and the revenue will follow”**

If I have a convo going pretty well, rapport is built and I know where they are in their business I will offer a Quick triage call that's usually 10- 15 mins. I will help them with a **quick win**, something that they have a **small problem** with.

*(In Today’s time I don’t have to do this, we close big sales without calls)*

We just want to show them that we know our shit without giving the farm away.

If they say no to the call, I tell them I can send a Video explaining how to fix problem ABC and 9 times out of 10 they agree to one or the other. These can be repurposed videos or you can record them on the fly and then repurpose over and over. 

If they refuse any free help you probably shouldn't waste your time as they may not have a problem or they're just not aware of it. Spend your time on people that want your help.

**Quick wins Could be help with  Lead Gen, Content creation, their offer, 2 Steps etc.**

I genuinely will just try to help them, wanting **nothing in return.**

What does this do? 

**It builds that Know, Like and Trust. This is overlooked and underrated.**

Now this person knows you can help them, as you just helped them for free fix one of their issues.

Follow up with them in a couple days to see how things are going.

It's been proven that **7 to 12 touch points** are needed before a **purchase** is made.

The more you follow up in a non needy way the more likely you are to get a sale from the right people

Your main goal is to get them on a call, now that you have helped them out and they will be more likely to open up with the bigger problem they currently have. This is when you will know whether your offer is for them or not. And it will be so much easier to Transition to talking about your offer and closing the sale. Only if its a good fit of course.

*( What we help folks do today is skip the calls and create Content that does all the heavy lifting before the convo ever takes place and folks pay us \$1k-\$6k for our products and services with a smile on their face. If you want help doing this, keep reading and you have a chance to see how you can do this)*

When people are on a call it's a bit harder for them to lie about their problems, calls are more intimate and they tend to open up easier.

Transitioning to your offer can be as simple as “ **With everything you’ve told me I actually have the Perfect solution for that. Is it cool if I share what will help you hit your goal of XYZ?**

They will more than likely want to hear what you have to say. Now it's up to you to handle the delivery of your Offer and knock the objections down with your knowledge and leverage of already solving one of their problems.

*(Again, our process today completely removes the calls, we’ve done multi 6 figures without sales calls in less than 2 years. Probably north of \$350,000 at this point)*

I hear this objection the most  “ **Well that's just too much for me right now even though I know it will fix XYZ”**

This is a great position for you Especially if your offer has **financing options** Which most of your offers do.  You can reply with “ **Well you’ve told me that you’ve had this problem for “X” amount of time. Can you Go another “X” amount of months without solving this problem?**

Or “ **This Problem is keeping you at “3k” of income each month, You could be at “6k” per month if the problem is solved. So by not solving your problem you're leaving another “3k” on the table every month you don't fix this problem. Over 6 months you're losing 18k in revenue.**

This will paint a picture for them and **your Offer Price will seem like pennies** especially with financing options. **Close the Sale**

***The truth is , and this goes for everyone, that there is a cost of inaction. Just like if you drive a car with no oil in, eventually the problem gets worse and costs you even more. Better to address the problem asap.***

The ball is in your court, we want to be ethical and only make our Offer if we’re 100% sure it's a good fit and will help solve their problem.

Your Goal should be a few Triage calls or sending a few Problem solving Videos each week   
Shoot for 10 Triage calls which should be roughly 5 to say Yes and if executed properly should land you 1-3 sales if you have a solid and validated Offer\! The more calls  the Better (If you’re not Confident in Your Offer Let me know and we can Book a call to put a no brainer offer together) \*winky face\*

*(This is also building up your digital assets while helping other people, these become things you can bolt on to your offers as bonuses or sell as a stand alone for profit)*

So in short, you should be booking as many calls as possible with people you know you can help. This Strategy is super simple but if Executed will result in more Opportunity to present your offer. This works really well with existing convos as well as cold leads. Most people want to be led. Everyone likes to buy but hates to be sold.
